name: io.github.synchronicity-labs/mcp-server
title: sync. labs
description: Lipsync videos, dub them into other languages, make talking videos and open sync. Studio.

environmentVariables.name: SYNC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: sync. API key from https://sync.so/settings/api-keys. Without one, the server starts a device login on first run.

environmentVariables.name: SYNC_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to list: default, lipsync, dubbing, assets, projects, transcription, voices, admin or all. Defaults to the hosted server's tools without deletes or voice cloning.
